verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OKWAGALA-okutaggwaawo
Okw'olubeerera,
Kukulukuta n'amaanyi,
Ge mazzi agataggwaawo-.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ffe tetuyinza kulinnya,
Mukama Kristo-akke:
Ye abeera wonna-wonna,
Tewali w'abula.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naye ye Mubeezi waffe
-Atubeera bulijjo;
Alabwa mu kizikiza
Ne mu kwagala-era.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ebyambalo bye byawonya,
Endwadde z'abantu;
tumweyune bwe tulumwa,
Tuwonere ddala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
-Okwagala-okutagambika,
-Erinnya lyo liwonya,
Okukugaana kwe kufa,
Ggwe-olina obulamu-
